name: nily-plugins
description: Nily's personal Claude Code plugins — installable workflow automations for daily engineering rituals.

plugins.name: jira-flow
plugins.description: Daily Jira flow: /jira-flow:story morning kickoff + /jira-flow:wrap-up approved progress comment

plugins.name: quartermaster
plugins.description: Tracker-agnostic story-to-review flow: /quartermaster:story kicks off an issue from Jira or Linear (detects the tracker, asks when unsure); /quartermaster:plan proposes a risk tier + file inventory; /quartermaster:review dispatches code + security reviews by tier and fingerprints the approval to the exact diff

plugins.name: lesson-tracker
plugins.description: Trackers agents and humans both work against: every task has an owner (you or an agent), a testable goal and a check; agents do or teach the work by those rules, log every check, and write typed lessons into an Obsidian agent memory at retro time.
